meta.title: The same toy, through an engineer's eyes
meta.desc: A Technic-compatible trophy truck designed the way a vehicle engineer would – the 3D model is built by AI in SOLIDWORKS via MCP.
hero.title:
The same toy,
through an engineer's eyes.
hero.sub: A Technic-compatible trophy truck, from requirements to finite elements. I didn't draw the 3D model: AI built it in SOLIDWORKS, through MCP.
story.title: Childhood Technic, grown-up questions.
story.p1: As a kid I built suspensions and gearboxes from Technic parts. Today I'm a vehicle engineer, and my son builds a lot too.
story.p2: The question: what if we designed a toy car the way we design a real one? Requirements, steering geometry, suspension kinematics, driveline, strength – the full engineering process, at toy scale.
story.p3: The twist: AI builds the model in SOLIDWORKS, through an MCP server. I'm the client: I decide, approve, and step in where hands are needed. Everything is digital: CAD, animation, FEM, film, website.
story.s1d: Baja-style trophy truck: long travel, all-wheel drive, a moving fake V8
story.s2d: Ackermann, kinematics, ratios, axle torsion – in Python
story.s3d: AI models parametric part families in SOLIDWORKS
story.s4d: code-driven animation, finite elements with CalculiX
story.s5d: synthetic narration, static website, open code
ai.title: One conductor, many agents, one SOLIDWORKS.
ai.intro: An orchestrator chat plans and conducts; parallel agents do the work. The project documents are the shared memory. SOLIDWORKS is driven through a local MCP server.
ai.agentsD: calc · CAD library · mock-up · FEM · render · video · web

ai.n3: tokens in a single calculation-agent run
ai.c1: Volume, position and interference after every step. 5-hole beam: expected 1300.4 mm³, SOLIDWORKS 1300.6 mm³.
ai.c2: A mate pushed a pin the wrong way (z = 5.0 instead of 3.6). The AI queried the positions and re-added it with the opposite direction.
ai.c3: Installing on a company machine, knowing the audience, and the brakes: “tell me before you launch a process.”
